faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for University of Kerala Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 8 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in University of Kerala Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Research Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for University of Kerala Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 8 December 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 12500 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's Degree in Political Science / Politics, IR and Diplomacy from a recognized university with at least 60% marks (55% for SC/ST candidates); research skills, good English communication, working knowledge of MS Office and basic data analysis tools.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Demonstrated research skills including literature review, academic writing, and data handling. Good communication skills in English. Working knowledge of MS Office and basic data analysis tools.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting. Interview (online/offline). Shortlisted candidates will be informed via email for an interview. Interview may be online or offline.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Duration: One year. Post is for a research project on Vizhinjam Port.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Science Policy Institute, Department of Political Science, University of Kerala.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: CV; Brief Statement of Interest (not exceeding 300 words); Scanned copies of relevant certificates.
